title: De Lima tells China: ‘Walk the talk’ first on peace ahead of Asean

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China should first show its commitment to regional peace through concrete actions before it actively participates in the upcoming Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit, Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima said. De Lima in a statement on Tuesday said that China cannot yearn to participate in certain Asean discussions and be a mediator when their aggressive actions over the West Philippine Sea (WPS) contradicts this. “Unless China stops spreading lies and disinformation, puts an end to its baseless claims over the West Philippine Sea, and ceases its aggressions against our fishermen, Coast Guard, and Navy […]...
